title: UI state document
description: What the agent shows in a conversation (design A.10): the record or view it brought into view, the panels it set, its open questions, and the agent-context panel. Changed only by the ui tool and the watcher, through JSON Patch events (ui.patch).

show.description: The last ui.show: a record reference or a client view id.

panels.description: Panel name to content. The agent-context panel has computed parts written by the watcher and a needs list written by the agent.

asks.description: Open and answered questions from ui.ask, keyed by ask id.

reactions.description: The user's reactions to agent messages, keyed by the client's message id (design A.5). Written by the bridge through /ui-action; the agent sees new ones at its next turn.
